sentences.s: It is a wise father that knows his own child, but today a man can boost his paternal (fatherly) wisdom—or at least confirm that he's the kid's dad.

trunk.宾语或表语: a wise father / his paternal wisdom
trunk.主干翻译: 能了解自己孩子的父亲才算聪明；但如今一个男人可以提升自己作为父亲的智慧。

components.原文: that knows his own child
components.中文翻译: 了解自己孩子的
components.说明: 强调句式 It is...that... 实际等同于含蓄让步的谚语，that 从句修饰 a wise father，意为'能了解自己孩子的父亲才算聪明'。

components.原文: but today a man can boost his paternal (fatherly) wisdom—or at least confirm that he's the kid's dad
components.中文翻译: 但如今一个男人可以提升自己作为父亲的智慧——或者至少证实自己就是孩子的父亲
components.说明: but 连接前后两个分句，构成对比并列。

components.原文: or at least confirm that he's the kid's dad
components.中文翻译: 或者至少证实自己就是孩子的父亲
components.说明: or 连接 boost 与 confirm 两个并列谓语动词。

components.原文: that he's the kid's dad
components.中文翻译: 他就是这孩子的父亲
components.说明: that 引导，作 confirm 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 能了解自己孩子的父亲才算聪明；但如今一个男人可以提升自己作为父亲的智慧——或者至少证实自己就是这孩子的父亲。

sentences.s: All he needs to do is shell out $30 for a paternity testing kit (PTK) at his local drugstore—and another $120 to get the results.

trunk.宾语或表语: shell out $30 for a paternity testing kit
trunk.主干翻译: 他所要做的全部就是（去当地药店）花30美元买一套亲子鉴定试剂盒。

components.原文: he needs to do
components.中文翻译: 他需要做的
components.说明: 省略了关系代词 that，修饰主语 All。

components.原文: to do
components.中文翻译: 去做（的事）
components.说明: 动词不定式作 needs 的宾语/补足成分。

components.原文: shell out $30 for a paternity testing kit (PTK) at his local drugstore—and another $120 to get the results
components.中文翻译: （去）当地药店花30美元买一套亲子鉴定试剂盒——再花120美元拿到检测结果
components.说明: 作表语的不定式短语省略了 to（系动词 is 后省 to），shell out 为表语动词。

components.原文: (PTK)
components.中文翻译: （即PTK）
components.说明: paternity testing kit 的缩写，作同位说明。

components.原文: and another $120 to get the results
components.中文翻译: 再花另外120美元（以拿到结果）
components.说明: and 连接，与 shell out $30 并列，承前省略 shell out。

components.原文: to get the results
components.中文翻译: 以拿到检测结果
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，说明花120美元的目的。

sentences.zh: 他所要做的全部就是去当地药店花30美元买一套亲子鉴定试剂盒（PTK）——再花另外120美元来拿到检测结果。

sentences.s: More than 60,000 people have purchased the PTKs since they first became available without prescriptions last year, according to Doug Fogg, chief operating officer of Identigene, which makes the over-the-counter kits.

trunk.主干翻译: 超过6万人购买了这种亲子鉴定试剂盒。

components.原文: since they first became available without prescriptions last year
components.中文翻译: 自从去年它们首次无需处方即可买到以来
components.说明: since 引导时间状语从句，与现在完成时呼应。

components.原文: according to Doug Fogg, chief operating officer of Identigene, which makes the over-the-counter kits
components.中文翻译: 据Identigene公司首席运营官道格·福格所言
components.说明: according to 短语作消息来源，作全句状语。

components.原文: chief operating officer of Identigene
components.中文翻译: Identigene公司的首席运营官
components.说明: 名词短语作 Doug Fogg 的同位语，说明其身份。

components.原文: which makes the over-the-counter kits
components.中文翻译: （该公司）生产这种非处方试剂盒
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 Identigene。

sentences.zh: 据生产这种非处方试剂盒的Identigene公司首席运营官道格·福格所言，自从去年这种试剂盒首次无需处方即可买到以来，已有超过6万人购买了它。

sentences.s: More than two dozen companies sell DNA tests directly to the public, ranging in price from a few hundred dollars to more than $2500.

trunk.主干翻译: 二十多家公司直接向公众出售DNA检测。

components.原文: ranging in price from a few hundred dollars to more than $2500
components.中文翻译: 价格从几百美元到2500多美元不等
components.说明: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明 DNA tests 的价格幅度。

sentences.zh: 二十多家公司直接向公众出售DNA检测，价格从几百美元到2500多美元不等。

sentences.s: Among the most popular: paternity and kinship testing, which adopted children can use to find their biological relatives and families can use to track down kids put up for adoption.

trunk.主干翻译: 最受欢迎的是亲子鉴定和亲缘鉴定。

components.原文: which adopted children can use to find their biological relatives and families can use to track down kids put up for adoption
components.中文翻译: 被收养的孩子可以用它来寻找亲生亲属，家庭也可以用它来找到被送养的孩子
components.说明: which 引导定语从句，修饰 paternity and kinship testing，从句内含两个并列分句共用 which。

components.原文: to find their biological relatives
components.中文翻译: 来寻找他们的亲生亲属
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，说明 use 的目的。

components.原文: and families can use to track down kids put up for adoption
components.中文翻译: 家庭也可以用它来找到被送养的孩子
components.说明: and 连接定语从句内的第二个并列分句。

components.原文: to track down kids put up for adoption
components.中文翻译: 来找到被送养的孩子
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语。

components.原文: put up for adoption
components.中文翻译: 被送养的（孩子）
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 kids。

sentences.zh: 其中最受欢迎的是亲子鉴定和亲缘鉴定：被收养的孩子可以借此寻找自己的亲生亲属，而家庭也可以借此找到被送出收养的孩子。

sentences.s: DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists—and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.

trunk.主干翻译: DNA检测也是热门时尚，并扶持了一些企业。

components.原文: and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots
components.中文翻译: 并扶持了那些提供寻找家族地理根源服务的企业
components.说明: and 连接 is 与 supports 两个并列谓语。

components.原文: that offer to search for a family's geographic roots
components.中文翻译: 提供寻找家族地理根源（服务）的
components.说明: that 引导定语从句，修饰 businesses。

components.原文: to search for a family's geographic roots
components.中文翻译: 去寻找一个家族的地理根源
components.说明: 不定式作 offer 的宾语。

sentences.zh: DNA检测也是热衷于家谱研究者中最新的潮流，并扶持了那些提供寻找家族地理根源服务的企业。

sentences.s: Most tests require collecting cells by swabbing saliva in the mouth and sending it to the company for testing.

trunk.主干翻译: 大多数检测都需要采集细胞。

components.原文: collecting cells by swabbing saliva in the mouth and sending it to the company for testing
components.中文翻译: 通过擦拭口腔中的唾液来采集细胞，并把它寄给公司进行检测
components.说明: 动名词短语作 require 的宾语。

components.原文: and sending it to the company for testing
components.中文翻译: 并把它寄给公司进行检测
components.说明: and 连接 swabbing 与 sending 两个并列动名词，均为 by 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 大多数检测都需要通过擦拭口腔中的唾液来采集细胞，然后把它寄给公司进行检测。

sentences.s: All tests require a potential candidate with whom to compare DNA.

trunk.主干翻译: 所有检测都需要一个潜在的对照对象。

components.原文: with whom to compare DNA
components.中文翻译: 用来与之比对DNA的
components.说明: with whom 引导的不定式定语从句，修饰 candidate。

sentences.zh: 所有检测都需要一个可供比对DNA的潜在对照对象。

trunk.主干翻译: 一些观察者持怀疑态度。

sentences.zh: 但一些观察者对此持怀疑态度。

sentences.s: "There's a kind of false precision being hawked by people claiming they are doing ancestry testing," says Troy Duster, a New York University sociologist.

components.原文: There's a kind of false precision being hawked by people claiming they are doing ancestry testing
components.中文翻译: 有一种虚假的精确性正被那些声称在做血统检测的人兜售
components.说明: 引语整体作 says 的宾语（倒装在前）。

components.原文: being hawked by people claiming they are doing ancestry testing
components.中文翻译: 正被……人兜售的
components.说明: 现在分词被动式作后置定语，修饰 false precision。

components.原文: claiming they are doing ancestry testing
components.中文翻译: 声称自己在做血统检测的
components.说明: 现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 people。

components.原文: they are doing ancestry testing
components.中文翻译: 他们在做血统检测
components.说明: 省略 that，作 claiming 的宾语从句。

components.原文: a New York University sociologist
components.中文翻译: 一位纽约大学的社会学家
components.说明: 名词短语作 Troy Duster 的同位语。

sentences.zh: 纽约大学社会学家特洛伊·杜斯特说：'那些声称在做血统检测的人正在兜售一种虚假的精确性。'

sentences.s: He notes that each individual has many ancestors—numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.

trunk.宾语或表语: that each individual has many ancestors
trunk.主干翻译: 他指出每个人都有许多祖先。

components.原文: that each individual has many ancestors—numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back
components.中文翻译: 每个人都有许多祖先——仅仅几个世纪前就数以百计
components.说明: that 引导，作 notes 的宾语从句。

components.原文: numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back
components.中文翻译: 仅在几个世纪前就数以百计
components.说明: 现在分词短语作后置定语/伴随，修饰 ancestors。

sentences.zh: 他指出，每个人都有许多祖先——仅仅几个世纪以前，祖先的数量就已多达数百人。

sentences.s: Yet most ancestry testing only considers a single lineage, either the Y chromosome inherited through men in a father's line or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers.

trunk.主干翻译: 大多数血统检测只考虑单一的世系。

components.原文: either the Y chromosome inherited through men in a father's line or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers
components.中文翻译: 要么是通过父系男性遗传的Y染色体，要么是只从母亲那里传下来的线粒体DNA
components.说明: either...or... 名词结构作 a single lineage 的同位语，进一步解释。

components.原文: inherited through men in a father's line
components.中文翻译: 通过父系一脉的男性遗传下来的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 Y chromosome。

components.原文: or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers
components.中文翻译: 或是只从母亲那里遗传的线粒体DNA
components.说明: either...or... 连接两个并列名词，与 Y chromosome 并列。

components.原文: which is passed down only from mothers
components.中文翻译: 只从母亲那里传下来的
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 mitochondrial DNA。

sentences.zh: 然而，大多数血统检测只考虑单一的世系，要么是通过父系男性遗传下来的Y染色体，要么是只从母亲那里传下来的线粒体DNA。

sentences.s: This DNA can reveal genetic information about only one or two ancestors, even though, for example, just three generations back people also have six other great-grandparents or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents.

trunk.主干翻译: 这种DNA只能揭示关于一两个祖先的遗传信息。

components.原文: even though, for example, just three generations back people also have six other great-grandparents or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents
components.中文翻译: 尽管举例来说，仅三代以前，人们还有另外六位曾祖父母，或四代以前还有另外十四位高祖父母
components.说明: even though 引导让步状语从句。

components.原文: or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents
components.中文翻译: 或者四代以前还有另外十四位高祖父母
components.说明: or 连接，与 six other great-grandparents 并列，承前省略 people have。

sentences.zh: 这种DNA只能揭示关于一两个祖先的遗传信息，尽管举例来说，仅仅三代以前，人们还有另外六位曾祖父母，而四代以前则还有另外十四位高祖父母。

sentences.s: Critics also argue that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared.

trunk.宾语或表语: that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections
trunk.主干翻译: 批评者还认为商业基因检测的好坏取决于参照数据库。

components.原文: that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared
components.中文翻译: 商业基因检测只与样本所比对的参照数据库一样好
components.说明: that 引导，作 argue 的宾语从句，内含 as...as 比较结构。

components.原文: to which a sample is compared
components.中文翻译: 样本与之进行比对的
components.说明: to which 引导定语从句，修饰 reference collections。

sentences.zh: 批评者还认为，商业基因检测的可靠程度，仅取决于样本所比对的那些参照数据库的好坏。

sentences.s: Databases used by some companies don't rely on data collected systematically but rather lump together information from different research projects.

trunk.主干翻译: 数据库并不依赖数据，而是把信息混杂在一起。

components.原文: used by some companies
components.中文翻译: 被一些公司使用的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 Databases。

components.原文: collected systematically
components.中文翻译: 系统采集的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 data。

components.原文: but rather lump together information from different research projects
components.中文翻译: 而是把来自不同研究项目的信息混杂在一起
components.说明: not...but rather... 连接两个并列谓语 rely 与 lump together。

sentences.zh: 一些公司使用的数据库并不依赖系统采集的数据，而是把来自不同研究项目的信息混杂在一起。

sentences.s: This means that a DNA database may have a lot of data from some regions and not others, so a person's test results may differ depending on the company that processes the results.

trunk.宾语或表语: that a DNA database may have a lot of data...
trunk.主干翻译: 这意味着一个DNA数据库可能有大量数据。

components.原文: that a DNA database may have a lot of data from some regions and not others, so a person's test results may differ depending on the company that processes the results
components.中文翻译: 一个DNA数据库可能拥有来自某些地区而非其他地区的大量数据，因此一个人的检测结果可能因处理结果的公司不同而有所差异
components.说明: that 引导，作 means 的宾语从句，从句内含 so 引导的结果分句。

components.原文: so a person's test results may differ depending on the company that processes the results
components.中文翻译: 因此一个人的检测结果可能因处理结果的公司不同而有所差异
components.说明: so 引导结果状语，与前半句构成因果。

components.原文: that processes the results
components.中文翻译: 处理结果的
components.说明: that 引导定语从句，修饰 the company。

sentences.zh: 这意味着，一个DNA数据库可能拥有来自某些地区而非其他地区的大量数据，因此一个人的检测结果可能会因处理结果的公司不同而有所差异。

sentences.s: In addition, the computer programs a company uses to estimate relationships may be patented and not subject to peer review or outside evaluation.

trunk.主干翻译: （公司所用的）计算机程序可能受专利保护。

components.原文: a company uses to estimate relationships
components.中文翻译: 公司用来估算亲缘关系的
components.说明: 省略关系代词 that/which，修饰 the computer programs。

components.原文: to estimate relationships
components.中文翻译: 用来估算亲缘关系
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，说明 uses 的目的。

components.原文: and not subject to peer review or outside evaluation
components.中文翻译: 且不接受同行评议或外部评估
components.说明: and 连接两个并列表语 patented 与 not subject to...。

sentences.zh: 此外，公司用来估算亲缘关系的计算机程序可能受专利保护，因而不接受同行评议或外部评估。
